Lists first-class chat conversations for the active app user. Playground may consume this API, but the backend path is owned by the product chat domain. Reads ai_chat_conversation, ai_agent_session. Writes none. File targets none.

get.description: Returns one tenant-scoped chat conversation using its stable conversation id. Reads ai_chat_conversation, ai_agent_session. Writes none. File targets none.

Lists normalized chat messages for one conversation. Each message exposes stable conversation and turn ids, not internal database surrogate ids. Reads ai_chat_conversation, ai_chat_turn, ai_chat_item, ai_chat_message, ai_chat_message_part, ai_runtime_usage_link, ai_runtime_artifact. Writes none. File targets none.

post.description: Creates one conversational turn with input and output item slots. Provider responses from Claude Code, Gemini, Codex, OpenAI-compatible runtimes, or custom runtimes are tracked through runtime invocation, event, usage, and artifact tables. Reads ai_chat_conversation, ai_agent_session. Writes ai_chat_turn, ai_chat_item, ai_chat_message, ai_chat_message_part, ai_chat_context_snapshot, ai_runtime_invocation, ai_runtime_invocation_event, ai_runtime_usage_link, ai_runtime_artifact.
